text: Removal of the H3K9me3 mark — e.g. by injecting the H3K9 demethylase KDM4A/KDM4E or depleting SUV39H1/H2 — does improve reprogramming efficiency in SCNT, with direct supporting evidence in human oocytes (Chung et al. 2015, Nature: KDM4A mRNA raised human SCNT blastocyst and ESC-derivation rates) and corroborating SCNT evidence in this KB corpus primarily from bovine embryos (KDM4E relieves a persistent H3K9me3/2 barrier at EGA, PMID 4547102), so the claim is supported subject to the caveat that the KB-retrieved proof is largely non-human.
